question: In agentic_cad, what happens end to end when a chamfer is applied to selected geometry: where can the command originate, how is its scope chosen, how does it change and render the body, and how do undo and redo restore it?

requiredFacts.description: The face and edge UI controls send ChamferSelected with the current chamfer distance, the clear-edge control sends distance zero, and the agent's chamfer tool requires a numeric distance and produces the same CadCommand.

CommandPlugin registers CadCommand as a Bevy event, OperationsPlugin registers process_chamfer in Update, and that system ignores other variants and applies each chamfer command only to queried ExtrudedBody entities carrying SelectedBody.

A nonempty SelectedEdges list wins and its indices are reduced modulo the base-point count; otherwise top or bottom face means every edge, a side face means its modulo-normalized edge, and no sub-selection also means every edge.

Before mutation process_chamfer clones the complete prior edge_ops vector; it replaces only resolved indices with EdgeOp::Chamfer(distance) when distance is positive or EdgeOp::None when it is zero or negative, preserving both the previous and complete new vectors.

The body mesh is regenerated from base points, height, and per-edge operations; chamfer inset is capped at 40% of height, adjacent edge insets shape top vertices, the chamfer strip joins side height to the inset top, and the new Mesh replaces the asset behind the body's existing Mesh3d handle.

After mesh replacement the operation pushes one HistoryEntry::EdgeOp containing the entity plus previous and new operation vectors; push_undo evicts the oldest entry at the 200-entry limit and clears the redo stack before recording the new undo entry.

Undo queues a deferred EdgeOpUndoCommand with previous_ops and moves the entry to redo; redo queues the same command with new_ops and returns the entry to undo; when applied, the command replaces edge_ops only if the entity still has ExtrudedBody, regenerates its mesh, and updates the existing mesh asset only when the Mesh3d handle and Assets resource are available.

answerIncludesAny: chamfer despawns and replaces the body entity
a new body entity is created for each chamfer
chamfer requires an explicitly selected edge
face and body selection cannot apply chamfer
undo restores a stored mesh snapshot
